entities.summary: Robert Cortez Scott is an American politician and lawyer serving as the U.S. representative for Virginia's 3rd congressional district since 1993. A member of the Democratic Party, he is the dean of Virginia's congressional delegation since 2019, he previously shared the deanship with Bob Goodlatte until the latter's retirement that year, and the first Filipino American voting member of Congress. The district serves most of the majority-black precincts of Hampton Roads, including all of the independent cities of Norfolk, Newport News, Hampton and Portsmouth, and parts of the independent city of Chesapeake.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As the first Filipino American voting member of Congress, Bobby Scott's election in 1993 marked a significant milestone for representation and diversity in the US Congress. His legislative efforts have had a lasting impact on issues affecting the Asian American community.
